root_cause: During P2 review, oversized query strings raised TooManyFieldsSent before API middleware finalized the response, producing HTML without trace/cache headers or a debug-rendering error. DRF's default format query override also intercepted unknown format parameters before strict query validation and returned 404 instead of 400.
fix_summary: Catch query field-limit exceptions after establishing a safe header-based locale and return a sanitized JSON 400 with request ID, language and no-store headers in both debug modes. Disable DRF URL format override so bootstrap query fields all pass through the strict serializer.
